title: fix(studio): an edit typed as a Save ends survives the Save's re-read of the object
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ82MfFjFxvJRAyoku6XCvWt4)_

Fixes #36648
Fixes #36653

## What changes

- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the Data pillar's object load: a re-read on the live-metadata pulse alone (`refreshOnly`) no longer clears the dirty flag, the kept CEL verdicts and the served verdict as its effect starts. It drops them when it installs, after the existing in-flight check (`refreshOnly && objBuffersHeldRef.current` ⇒ keep the buffer). A full load (another object, a publish, a reload) resets at the start as before.
- New `DataPillar.pulseAfterSave-36648.test.tsx` (2 cases): types into the window deterministically (the hook wrapped to report its release; the keystroke runs in the microtask after it) and pins that the edit stays, that a valid one is sent by the next Save, and that an unparsable one is held. Both cases fail on `main` (`expected '' to be …`: the edit is gone) and pass here.
- `DataPillar.panelGate.test.tsx` and `panelHold-27629` are untouched: nothing skipped, retried, narrowed or slowed.

## Why — root cause (product, pre-existing; not #36636)

The red in run 45133910959 is the **second** Save of the first case (`panelGate.test.tsx:166`): `findByTestId('studio-save')` ran its full 4 s and the button never came back after the case typed `record.status ==`. The button is drawn only while the page holds an edit, so the edit was gone.

A Save's publish sends the live-metadata pulse. The pillar holds it while the buffer has work (`useMetadataRefreshNonce(objBuffersHeld)`) and releases it in an effect the moment the Save ends; the next render's load effect re-reads the object. That effect called `setDirty(false)` (and cleared the verdicts) **as it started**, before the in-flight check. A keystroke landing between the release and that effect therefore lost its dirty flag; the read, finding nothing held, installed the server's body over it; the edit and the Save button went with it. The window is one scheduler gap, which a loaded merge-queue runner can open between the case's Save and its next keystroke. For an author it is a keystroke right after pressing Save that silently disappears.

Not #36636: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and `useMetadataRefreshNonce.ts` are byte-identical between #36636's parent `99ece3c4` and `main`; the window predates it. #36636 changed only when Save reads `held`, before any write.

## Verification

Loaded box: 4-core container, 4 busy-loop CPU stressors, `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, 20 consecutive runs.

| tree | files | runs | red |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| #36636's parent `99ece3c4` | panelGate | 20 | 2: both `expected "vi.fn()" to not be called` (:167, :175), the #36619 verdict race #36636 fixed |
| `main` `e9fa6b5d` | panelGate | 20 | 0 (the :166 timeout did not recur in 20; the deterministic case above reproduces it) |
| this head `6e21473c` | panelGate + panelHold-27629 + pulseAfterSave-36648 | 20 | 0: 20 of 20 green in a row, all 10 cases each run |

Also green locally: every studio-design test file that saves through the top bar, reads the pulse, or is a `DataPillar.*` suite (50 files, 259 tests).

## Also: the unit-project red that blocked this PR (#36653)

`Test UI (7/16)` went red on `romanizeHan.test.ts:24` (`expected ' weixiu  zhongxin ' to be '维修中心'`), a file the fix above does not touch. Cause: test order, not product. The `unit` project runs files with `isolate: false`; `layout/__tests__/designModeMenuCreate-36364.test.ts` (landed 08:11Z with #36606) calls `loadHanRomanizer()` in its `beforeAll`, so when it ran earlier in the same worker the shared `romanizeHan` module was already loaded and the "before the dictionary has loaded" cases read romanized text.

- Reproduction: `vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=1 designModeMenuCreate-36364.test.ts romanizeHan.test.ts` fails at `:24` with CI's exact message on `main` `3cf6a44b`.
- Fix (separate commit, test only, no product code, no changeset): the before-load describe reads its own instance (`vi.resetModules()` + dynamic `import('./romanizeHan')`) and still pins "unchanged and pending until loaded"; a new case pins that the same instance stops being pending once it loads. Nothing skipped, retried or narrowed.
- Counts: neighbour first, `--maxWorkers=1`, 4 busy-loop CPU stressors on a 4-core box, 20 consecutive runs: 20 of 20 green (red before). Alone: green.
